protocol.fixed_band_definition: three adjacent blocks for every count
protocol.full_band_definition: all block pairs at each count
protocol.holdout_prediction_definition: N=768 mean times (1024/768) to the calibration spectral slope
protocol.pooled_1024_definition: log-count extrapolation of the two calibration geometry scalars
protocol.pooled_scalar_definition: calibration-origin mean geometry at each training count
protocol.spectral_slope_definition: log2 slope of calibration-origin mean spectral values at N=512,768
